ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field covering both lobes. Low-intensity black borders along the trailing edges and median notch. Dense black accumulation at the fluke-peduncle junction. Two distinct isolated black blobs on the left lobe (approximate mid-section) and sparse punctate mottling on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a wide angle of approximately 110 degrees; notch depth is roughly 1/10th of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with minor, low-amplitude irregularities. The right lobe trailing edge is significantly more jagged with high-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys, particularly towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve extending from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters detected at both distal tips; the right tip contains a dense, high-relief cluster of calcareous-type formations (barnacles).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, jagged trailing edge on the right lobe suggesting prior physical trauma or wear; dense barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast black circular spot located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
